summary: The single commit on this orphan branch (d8f50ccc, 2026-04-26) adds turbopack.root = process.cwd() to next.config.ts to silence the Turbopack multiple-lockfile warning. The equivalent fix was merged the same day via PR #1338 (commit b0fbbeae) using the more reliable path.resolve(__dirname). The fix is the current state of next.config.ts on main (most recent commit touching that file). No unique content on this branch; safe to delete.
